headlineHtml: One manifest. From a €5 VPS to production. Open source.
subhead: AppRafter is an opinionated PaaS on Kubernetes. Describe your applications in a single CUE manifest — it runs on a single VDS today, and is designed to run unchanged on a multi-node production cluster (Tier 2, Phase 3). Open source (FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0). A managed version is coming for those who'd rather not run ops themselves.
statusBadge: v0.2 · Phase 2 shipped · live on Tier 1 (single VDS) · Tier 2 + managed in development
